system.description:
A FastFlesh Medpac offers a broader range of medical instruments and agents than a standard Medpac. Each FastFlesh Medpac has enough materials for a single use. A character who benefits from a FastFlesh Medpac or a standard Medpac cannot again derive benefits from any Medpac for 24 hours.

Using a FastFlesh Medpac grants you a +5 Equipment bonus to a Treat Injury check made to perform First Aid. Otherwise, this Medpac functions as a standard Medpac.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Threats of the Galaxy
